candidates.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: the referenced Mongol small ger game sprite. Preserve the ger design, wool-felt texture, wood door, rope bands, small woodpile, antique realistic game detail and upper-left light. Change ONLY camera and thin earth footprint geometry to exact orthographic 2:1 dimetric projection (45 degree yaw,30 degree elevation). Ground axes must be screen slopes +0.500 and -0.500 with NO perspective convergence. CRITICAL footprint 7:6 with left-to-front edge7 units and front-to-right edge6 units. Re-render on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Thin earth quadrilateral corners: LEFT(180,610), FRONT(810,925), RIGHT(1350,655), BACK(720,340). Trace the front ground edges directly between these points: LEFT→FRONT is630px across315px down; FRONT→RIGHT is540px across270px up. Do not revert to a symmetric square diamond. The four corners belong to the flat earth rectangle, not the roof. Keep whole ger comfortably inside this footprint, entrance faces LOWER LEFT, compact minor props inside. All geometry including door aligns with these axes. Natural weathered materials and fine restrained texture, no green scenery. True transparent alpha outside complete silhouette, generous margin, no colored background, halo, giant shadow, lettering, guide lines or markers. Ground is paper thin with visible straight geometric edges, not a thick podium. Keep only tiny lower-right contact shadow.

Edit the referenced Mongolian ger asset. Two REQUIRED changes: (1) remove ALL the golden/brown glow behind and around the object, replacing every outside pixel with fully transparent alpha=0, preserving solid opaque architecture. (2) Make the flat ground rectangle's FRONT CORNER move RIGHT until its LEFT FRONT EDGE is 7 units long and RIGHT FRONT EDGE is6 units long. Right now it is the wrong way round. BOTH front edges must have equal absolute angle26.565 degrees to horizontal, true 2:1 orthographic projection. Keep the ger smaller with more ground exposed so ground shape is perfectly legible. Floor dimensions 7 wide along left-front edge by6 deep along right-front edge. On final1536x1024 canvas ground corners approximately LEFT(180,580), FRONT(810,895), RIGHT(1350,625), REAR(720,310). The long edge has630horizontal315vertical, the short edge540horizontal270vertical. This is critical game grid alignment. Exact straight thin ground boundary, no podium. Keep historic cream felt, restrained brown ropes, rustic door, wooden chest and firewood, fine Song-style realistic asset texture, upper-left light, whole silhouette with transparent gutters. No background haze, halo, scenery, text, labels, grid or drawn guides. Output a clean opaque game sprite with TRUE transparent exterior.
